EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2884/2910/2939 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003) and a clear carbonyl band at 1712 cm⁻¹ consistent with a saturated ketone (GFQ-011). Esters (1, 6, 8) typically have ν(C=O) ≈1735–1750 cm⁻¹, imine (2) lacks C=O, alcohol (10) lacks C=O, aldehyde (7) would show aldehydic C–H bands near 2720–2820 cm⁻¹ (absent), and nitrite/diazo (5, 9) do not fit the carbonyl position. The mid-frequency bands at ~1040 and 1120 cm⁻¹ are compatible with aliphatic C–C skeletal modes, supporting an unfunctionalized chain ketone like candidate 3.
